Magnolia Southern Dining at Lakeside
Experience the rich traditions of Southern cooking through a rotating menu inspired by the Carolinas, Texas, Louisiana, and Florida. Signature dishes include smoky brisket, Nashville hot chicken, seafood gumbo, and fried green tomato po’boys, served with sides like collard greens, mac and cheese, and hush puppies. Desserts such as banana pudding, peach cobbler, and red velvet cake, along with sweet tea and peach punch, round out a dining experience that is both authentic and diverse for the West Campus community.
Star Ginger @ Wilbur inspired by Mai Pham
Nationally-acclaimed Chef Mai Pham of Sacramento’s Lemon Grass Kitchen and Star Ginger showcases her fresh Southeast Asian cuisine at Wilbur Dining’s Star Ginger. Menus feature the bright flavors of Vietnam, Thailand, and beyond, from hearty authentic Thai curries and grilled meats to fresh, flavorful Vietnamese noodle soups and salads.
Cardinal Sage @ Stern inspired by Iliana de la Vega
Prominent Mexican-born Chef Iliana de la Vega of Austin’s celebrated El Naranjo restaurant, incorporates her innovative Oaxacan flavors into the menu at Cardinal Sage, located at Stern Dining. The menus offer a range of modern Mexican favorites featuring slow-marinated meats, fresh house-made salsas, and flavorful rice and bean dishes cooked from scratch. Chef Iliana de la Vega's culinary genius was honored in 2022 with The James Beard Foundation's Best Chef award in the first-ever Texas category.
Spice Flower Kitchen @ Casper inspired by Mai Pham
Nationally-acclaimed Chef Mai Pham of Sacramento’s Lemon Grass Kitchen and Star Ginger showcases her fresh Southeast Asian cuisine at Casper’s Spicer Flower Kitchen. Spice Flower Kitchen celebrates Asian vegetarian cuisine. It features a wide range of flavors drawn from the vegetarian and vegan culinary traditions of India, Vietnam, Thailand, and beyond.  Many recipes are inspired by temple cooking and highlight seasonal, locally sourced ingredients whenever possible.
The rotating menus are also guided by Jain, Sattvic, and broader Hindu dietary principles. In keeping with these traditions, Spice Flower Kitchen does not use onions, garlic, or root vegetables. While our chefs strive to honor these practices, Spice Flower Kitchen occasionally incorporates select ground spices to achieve balance and flavor. If you have specific dietary needs or questions, our team is always happy to assist.
Allergen-Friendly Dining @ Branner
Branner Dining Hall stands as Stanford's first residential dining facility dedicated to allergen-friendly service, offering a full menu entirely free of the nine most common food allergens: milk, eggs, peanuts, tree nuts, soy, wheat, fish, shellfish, and sesame. As food allergies among students continue to rise nationally, SDHA has responded with a program that mirrors the variety and quality found across all campus dining halls while eliminating allergenic risk, from wheat- and dairy-free hamburger buns to nut-free pesto and dairy-free pizza crust. The result is a dining experience where safety and flavor coexist, ensuring every student, regardless of dietary restriction, can eat with confidence.
